scope: Independent manual review of declared writer, proof, extraction code, validator and completed compact results; no new source query, native image, full graph search or executable census rerun.
logic: Every subsequence of a sorted class subsequence remains sorted. Projecting daldy to dald and olaiin to la therefore gives necessary constraints, irrespective of classes or ranks assigned to the omitted y/o/i/n units.
If d and a shared a class, d-a-d could not be nondecreasing under a strict order on distinct symbols; similarly d-l-d prohibits a shared d/l class.
Two classes then force a and l together. dald demands a<l, while la demands l<a. No fixed strict order satisfies both.

Enumerating all eight assignments of d/a/l to two class labels is a relaxation: it includes assignments with one class empty on these three units. Global nonempty-class requirements cannot restore a solution absent in this larger domain.
All six strict total orders on d/a/l include the restriction of every global 22-symbol strict order. Zero solutions in the 48 reduced cases thus suffices; no enumeration of full keys is required.
A fixed bijective drawing renaming preserves repetition and relative-order constraints. The obstruction does not assign any source-letter value.
The triangle requires at least three classes for these selected constraints only; it proves neither full three-class feasibility nor an exact manuscript-wide minimum.

source_and_result_review.selection: Only exact standalone daldy and olaiin; each needs >=2 STRICT occurrences within its own reading. daldy witness fixed to f45r.10; earliest strict olaiin selected by source row then group index.

saved_validation.claim: Source and fixed-code implication only; no native semantic or palaeographic confirmation.

source_and_result_review.checks: Code retains all 144 exact-form P rows including excluded seams; validator independently tokenizes and rederives classification, counts, selector sets and selected witness records. Cache and classification hashes are locked. Validator checks all source pages against the 179-selector allowlist and excludes f84-prefix/f1r/f116v. This review inspected those checks rather than recollating every source row again.
source_and_result_review.no_pooling: All three reader decisions separately satisfy the stipulated recurrence and selected-locus conditions. They remain alternate transcriptions of one manuscript.

limits: Source-informed two-form certificate; not an unforeseen prediction, independently new manuscript evidence or significance test.
Literal working-unit identity, complete group boundaries, fixed symbol classes and strict order remain model assumptions.
No general exclusion of composition, interleaved classes, meaningful writing, three-class writers or languages.
No retrospective change to GDT1263 weak-rank or GDT1321 nonreturning-class results: their premises differ.
